findings.source_passage: Here was a man some twenty thousand miles from home, by the way of Cape Horn, that is—which was the only way he could get there—thrown among people as strange to him as though he were in the planet Jupiter
findings.why_it_matters: The parenthetical 'by the way of Cape Horn, that is—which was the only way he could get there' is a characteristic Ishmaelian digressive aside; its removal flattens the narrator's voice and loses the wry, self-interrupting tone that defines the passage's charm.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the parenthetical Cape Horn remark: 'twenty thousand miles from home, by the way of Cape Horn, that is—which was the only way he could get there—thrown among people as strange to him as though he were in the planet Jupiter.'

findings.source_passage: to be true philosophers, we mortals should not be conscious of so living or so striving. So soon as I hear that such or such a man gives himself out for a philosopher
findings.source_locator: end of the paragraph on Queequeg's philosophy
findings.why_it_matters: The draft skips the transitional sentence 'to be true philosophers, we mortals should not be conscious of so living or so striving' and jumps directly to the dyspeptic digester quip, losing the logical chain that gives the aphorism its rhetorical force and the narrator's ironic philosophical voice.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the sentence: 'But, perhaps, to be true philosophers, we mortals should not be conscious of so living or so striving.' before the dyspeptic digester remark.

findings.source_passage: I began to be sensible of strange feelings. I felt a melting in me.
findings.source_locator: paragraph beginning 'As I sat there in that now lonely room'
findings.why_it_matters: The draft keeps 'I felt a melting in me' but omits 'I began to be sensible of strange feelings,' erasing the double-beat rhetorical build-up that makes the emotional turn feel earned.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'I began to be sensible of strange feelings' immediately before 'I felt a melting in me.'

summary: The draft faithfully preserves all high-priority signature passages (the worship syllogism, 'hearts' honeymoon,' 'George Washington cannibalistically developed,' the atmospheric room paragraph, 'splintered heart and maddened hand,' etc.) but flattens two voice-defining digressions at medium severity and drops one rhetorical beat at low severity, none sufficient to trigger regeneration.
